name: Kilbeggan Distillery
scope: The historic Kilbeggan Distillery north of Bridge Street, with its whitewashed slate-roofed courtyard ranges, brick chimney, millrace and restored waterwheel.

review.notes: Verified the Qualla hero bytes match the Commons transfer. The earliest transfer lists both a public-domain claim and CC BY-SA, and the original upload log has no licensing text. Geometry follows written survey facts, native mapping and the original elevation field.
